Even when quite cold outside, this grill heats well and evenly across the entire grill surface.

Results.ReviewText: This is actually the 2nd Spirit E-210 gas grill I have purchased.  The first was a couple of years ago for a gal I was dating at the time.  When the time came to get another BBQ for myself there was no question I would get another.  It is the nicest BBQ I have used.

Results.ReviewText: Have owned a Weber grill for many many years. When it came time to add another one (smaller) I chose the Spirit E-210. After carefully reading the instructions, and several hours later I was ready to fire up my new grill. Much to my disappointment the gas valve turned out to be bad and was leaking badly.Weber did send a new one and all is fine. What I didn't like, was the customer service rep making it seem like it was most likely my problem (tank related) even though I explained that I took the tank off of another Weber grill. .
Results.Title: Great Grill...but

Results.ReviewText: Replaced my 2-burner Weber Genesis after 10+yrs, which was a downgrade from a 3-burner that also lasted a very long time.  So, I'm loyal to the brand because the quality of the components and excellent grilling results in a size that's just perfect for me.
Results.Title: Best in quality, perfect size!

Results.ReviewText: This grill was a replacement for a Lemon I had, would  not heat up but I have to say, both Weber and Lowes stood behind their product and replaced the grill with this newer model, it's a dream.  Cooks food quickly and heats up so fast, we love it!!

Results.Title: Great Grill

Results.ReviewText:
I got about 12 years out of my old weber spirit of heavy use. So yesterday I decided it was time to retire it. Every thing was still working, but i just wanted something fresh. Every part on it was its original, except the cast iron grates. 

My only complaint about my old grill was the cast iron grates. In about 12 years of owning it i replaced my cast iron grates about 3 times. It didn't matter how i seasoned the grates, they would still rust and flake. Hopefully this is something weber has addressed with the new model. But the overall built quality is A+.
Results.Title: Love weber grills

Results.ReviewText: Bought this for my husband’s Christmas gift. It had been such a great grill with even temps and easy to move around. Just the right size to fold up and put away.

Results.ReviewText: For those of you that simply want to sit the LP tank in a small round circle in this unit, forget it, the hole is so big the LP tank sits on the ground. Besides that, the LP tank mount is on the outside of the unit. This probably is a bone head mistake by the assembler. I had it returned. Not worth the hassle's, make it simple.

Results.ReviewText: I love cooking steaks on my Weber spirit e-210.  The grill gets super hot and I seer them on each side. The grill is very well constructed and I expect it to last a long time.

Results.Title: Great Grill

Results.ReviewText:
My grill I bought 23 years ago completely wore out so I purchased this Weber grill. It came unassembled, but was easy to put together and I was very impressed in how well it is made. 

Cooked our first steak and it tasted great and the Weber webpage is very helpful. I just did what it said to do and we had great tasting steaks. So, at this point we are quite pleased. We’ll see how it’s doing in 23 years.

Results.ReviewText: This is my second Weber gas grill. I had always just bought cheap grills and replaced them every few years. Bought first Weber gas about 10 years ago and although it still works was needing some major repairs. While I was shopping for other things I saw this one at a great price point so just bought my new one. Now have two and are very happy with the Best gas grills available.
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: Paid over $400 less than two years ago and burners quit working. This is the second Weber that has not lasted. Won’t buy another one!

Results.ReviewText: Great grill that folds up into a compact spot in my garage after use. Grilling area is perfect size for dinner for my family of 6. Has only the features I want and none that I don’t.  Great customer service from Weber for some self-induced damage.
Results.Title: Simple and compact design with Weber quality

46110001.Name: Spirit E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46110001.Description:
Taste the difference a Spirit will make in your life. With features such as porcelain enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking. Designed to fit on a small patio or balcony, the Spirit E-210 gas grill brings grilling to any home.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 360 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
